title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**About Stock Knocks**

India’s First AI-Powered Investor Research & IR Marketplace.

Where investors discover tomorrow’s companies, and businesses connect with verified investors through AI, videos and community.

Investors use Stock Knocks to research SME-listed and IPO-bound companies. They can ask questions about DRHPs, annual reports and investor presentations and get clear answers in seconds, in English and Indian languages. Companies use it to reach verified investors through investor-relations videos, live meetings and our community.

**The role**

You’ll grow both sides of the marketplace: the investors who come to research and the companies that want to reach them. On the investor side, you’ll own the funnel from the first ad someone sees to their tenth research question. On the company side, you’ll bring in a steady flow of SME and IPO-bound companies for our sales team to sign up. You’ll run campaigns yourself, set up the tracking, and run the tests that decide where our next rupee goes. You’ll work directly with the founders, product and sales.

**What you’ll do**

*Investor growth (B2C)*

* Plan, launch and optimise app-install and web campaigns on Google (App Campaigns, Search, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta and Apple Search Ads.
* Build keyword and audience plans around IPO and SME search demand: DRHP filings, subscription windows, allotment and listing days.
* Test creatives quickly: hooks, formats, languages and UGC-style video
* Improve the funnel: install → sign-up → first AI question → paid use → repeat use.
* Own lifecycle messaging on push, email and WhatsApp to activate new users and win back inactive ones

*Company growth (B2B)*

* Generate qualified leads from SME-listed companies, IPO-bound companies and their promoters through LinkedIn Ads, Google Search and targeted outreach campaigns.
* Build partnerships with merchant bankers, IPO consultants, CA firms and other intermediaries who work with these companies.
* Run webinars, events and case studies that show how companies use Stock Knocks to reach investors
* Work with sales on lead scoring, CRM handoff and follow-up, and track lead → meeting → onboarded company
* Build landing pages and pitch material for each segment (newly listed SMEs, pre-IPO companies, companies already listed on the main board)

*Organic & community*

* Build SEO and content around IPOs and SME stocks, such as IPO pages, DRHP explainers and listing-day coverage.
* Grow our community and creator partnerships on YouTube, X, Telegram, Instagram and LinkedIn, within SEBI’s rules on finfluencers

*Measurement*

* Own tracking across an attribution tool (AppsFlyer, Branch or Adjust), Firebase, GA4, GTM, Meta SDK and Conversions API, SKAN on iOS, and the LinkedIn Insight Tag
* Report investor metrics (cost per install, cost per activated user, conversion to paid, retention, lifetime value against acquisition cost) and company metrics (cost per qualified lead, lead-to-onboarding rate, acquisition cost per company)
* Use AI tools and automation for making creatives, bidding, reporting and analysis.

*Compliance*

* Make sure every campaign follows SEBI’s advertising rules, its disclosure and publicity rules for listed and IPO-bound companies, and Google’s and Meta’s financial-services policies: no promised returns, no stock tips, correct disclosures.

**What we’re looking for**

* 4–7 years in performance or growth marketing, with at least 2 years on a consumer app (fintech, investing, edtech or similar)
* Hands-on experience with Google App Campaigns and Meta app campaigns: you’ve run the budgets yourself, not just supervised them
* B2B lead generation experience, ideally on LinkedIn Ads, where you were measured on lead quality and not just volume
* Comfortable with an attribution tool and cohort analysis; you think about retention and payback, not just cost per install.
* Experience with CRM and lifecycle tools (HubSpot or Zoho for B2B; CleverTap, MoEngage or WebEngage for B2C)
* A record of tests you designed, ran and learned from, both wins and losses.
* A real interest in Indian capital markets: you know what a DRHP, an anchor book and allotment status are

**Good to have**

* Experience marketing a SEBI-regulated or financial-services product, including financial-services verification on Google and Meta
* Contacts among merchant bankers, IPO consultants or SME promoters
* Experience growing a two-sided marketplace
* SEO for high-intent, time-sensitive searches
* Campaigns or content in Hindi or other Indian languages
* Basic SQL or Python
* Experience as an early marketing hire at a startup

**Why join us**

* Grow both sides of a new kind of marketplace for India’s capital markets.
* An AI product you’ll use yourself every day
* A small team: your tests go live in days, not quarters
* Work directly with the founders and see your impact on the company's numbers.

title: Digital Marketing Paid Internship
description:
Location: Serampore, West Bengal, India

Job Type: Internship

Duration: 6 months

Monthly Stipend: ₹4,000

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM–3:00 PM

Openings: 1

Experience: Freshers only welcome

Work Arrangement: On-site

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SEO Intern to join our growing digital marketing business in Serampore, West Bengal.

This paid internship is suitable for freshers who want practical experience in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, website optimization, keyword research, backlink building, and content planning.

You will work on real SEO projects, learn industry-relevant techniques, and gain practical exposure to improving organic search visibility and website performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Local SEO and Google Business Profile

* Assist with Google Business Profile optimization and local search visibility.
* Conduct local keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Research topics for business profile updates and local landing pages.
* Assist with business citations and directory listings.
* Monitor local rankings and profile performance.

2. Website SEO

* Assist with on-page optimization, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and internal linking.
* Conduct keyword research and identify relevant search opportunities.
* Help identify basic technical and on-page SEO issues.
* Support website content optimization and SEO audits.
* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console and other SEO tools.

3. Backlink Building and Off-Page SEO

* Research relevant websites for potential backlink opportunities.
* Assist with outreach, link building, and business listings.
* Analyze competitor backlink profiles.
* Maintain backlink records and review link quality.

4. Content Research and Planning

* Research blog topics and SEO content opportunities.
* Prepare content calendars based on keyword research.
* Identify competitor content gaps and search intent.
* Suggest topics for websites and Google Business Profile updates.

5. Reporting and Analysis

* Track keyword rankings and organic search performance.
* Assist with weekly and monthly SEO reports.
* Research search engine updates and SEO best practices.

Eligibility Criteria

* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* A basic understanding of SEO or digital marketing is an advantage.
* Interest in Local SEO, website optimization, and keyword research.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel.
* Good research, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Willingness to learn, follow instructions, and complete assigned tasks responsibly.
* Ability to commute to our Serampore office for on-site work.

What You Will Learn

* Practical Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
* Keyword research and website SEO fundamentals.
* Backlink building and off-page SEO.
* Content strategy and competitor analysis.
* SEO reporting and performance tracking.
* Real-world SEO campaign execution.

About the Company

We are a newly established, founder-led digital marketing business that began operations in 2026. Our work focuses on SEO, local search visibility, Google Business Profile optimization, and website growth.

As a small and growing business, we offer the opportunity to learn directly through practical projects and gain exposure to different areas of SEO.

The internship includes a fixed monthly stipend of ₹4,000, a six-month duration, and Sunday off. Our goal is to provide a professional learning environment where motivated candidates can develop practical digital marketing skills.

title: Area Manager, Retail

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. title: Marketing Manager – Mall Marketing & Events
description:
**Company Description**
Established in 2011, Avani Riverside Mall is India’s first Green Mall, demonstrating that modern retail spaces can be both eco-friendly and customer-focused. The mall offers a diverse mix of experiences, including shopping, a movie theater, a game zone, and a food court that caters to a wide range of visitors. Its sustainable design and operations reflect a commitment to environmental responsibility while providing contemporary amenities. Avani Riverside Mall continues to grow as a destination for entertainment, leisure, and community events in the Howrah region.
  
**Role Description**
The Marketing Manager – Mall Marketing & Events will lead the planning and execution of all marketing initiatives and events for Avani Riverside Mall. This full-time, on-site role in Howrah involves developing annual marketing calendars, coordinating promotional campaigns, and driving footfall through innovative event concepts. The individual will oversee branding and visual communication within the mall, manage relationships with retailers, vendors, and agencies, and ensure consistent promotion of offers, festivals, and special activities. Daily responsibilities include monitoring campaign performance, managing budgets, supervising event logistics, and ensuring all activities align with the mall’s eco-friendly positioning. The role also requires analyzing visitor data, preparing reports for management, and collaborating closely with operations and leasing teams to enhance the overall customer experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in mall marketing, retail marketing, or event management, ideally within shopping centers or consumer-facing environments.
* Strong skills in campaign planning, brand promotion, and event conceptualization, with the ability to translate marketing strategy into on-ground activations.
* Proficiency in digital and social media marketing, including content planning, basic analytics, and coordination with creative and media partners.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills for working with tenants, vendors, agencies, and internal teams.
* Solid organizational and project management abilities, including budget handling, timeline management, and attention to detail in execution.
* Ability to work on-site in Howrah, with flexibility for weekend, holiday, and evening events as required by mall operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification or specialized certification in marketing or events is an advantage.
* Experience using MS Office or similar tools for reporting and presentations; familiarity with marketing analytics or CRM tools is beneficial.
* Creative mindset, customer-centric approach, and commitment to sustainable and eco-friendly practices in line with the mall’s positioning.

title: Stage Social Media en Online Marketing
description:
**Ben jij een student in de richting van marketing, communicatie of commerciële economie en zoek je een stage waarbij je écht invloed hebt? Wil je niet meekijken vanaf de zijlijn, maar zelf onderzoeken, adviseren en verbeteren? Dan hebben wij een interessante stageopdracht voor jou.**
**Wie zijn wij?**
Vitesse Vorkheftrucks is dé specialist in verhuur en onderhoud van vorkheftrucks en zwaar materieel (1,5 tot 45 ton) in het Rotterdamse havengebied. In 2016 zijn we onderdeel geworden van Toyota Material Handling Nederland, maar we blijven opereren als zelfstandig en lokaal betrokken team. Onze kracht? Flexibiliteit, snelheid en service – met een eigen transportbedrijf om snel te kunnen schakelen voor klanten.
  
  
**De stageopdracht**
Vitesse is actief op social media, maar we zien kansen om onze online zichtbaarheid verder te vergroten.
  
  
**Tijdens Jouw Stage Onderzoek Je**

* Hoe we onze social media naar een hoger niveau kunnen tillen.
* Welke content het beste aansluit bij onze doelgroep.
* Welke social media-kanalen interessant zijn voor Vitesse.
* Welke online communities, platforms of netwerken kansen bieden om onze zichtbaarheid te vergroten.
* Hoe we meer bereik, interactie en naamsbekendheid kunnen creëren.

Je vertaalt jouw onderzoek naar een praktisch advies en helpt waar mogelijk ook mee met de uitvoering van jouw ideeën.
  
  
**Wat bieden wij?**

* Een uitdagende en zelfstandige stage met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.
* Begeleiding door collega's uit verschillende afdelingen.
* Een organisatie waar jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk gehoord en gebruikt worden.
* Flexibiliteit in werkdagen en planning, waardoor de stage goed te combineren is met je studie.
* Een passende stagevergoeding.
* Een unieke kans om marketingervaring op te doen binnen een technische en commerciële organisatie.

**Wie zoeken wij?**
**Wij Zoeken Een Student Die**

* Een mbo- of hbo-opleiding volgt in de richting marketing, communicatie, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
* Nieuwsgierig, proactief en zelfstandig is.
* Interesse heeft in social media en online marketing.
* Graag onderzoek doet en met nieuwe ideeën komt.
* Niet bang is om collega's actief te benaderen voor informatie en inspiratie.

**Interesse?**
Lijkt het je leuk om de online zichtbaarheid van Vitesse Vorkheftrucks verder te ontwikkelen en jouw ideeën om te zetten in concrete adviezen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.
  
  
Je kunt hiervoor contact opnemen met Lilian de Haas via werving@vitessevorkheftrucks.nl. Liever eerst bellen? Bel dan naar 010-4293000.
